title: Finish3D: lid model and shallow step edges from the #2431 prototype

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
## Summary

The fix for #2431 joins the pieces of one raster line over a gap that is not wider than the ball. It does not include the other changes of the earlier prototype on #2431 (a comment by mkinney, built over PR #1713). This issue keeps those changes so that they are not lost.

## Items from the prototype

1. `crates/motion/src/finishing3d/fill.rs` (the land model, `fill_openings`):
   - `z_floor` is equal to `lo[2]`. The prototype found that closed holes on a flat open sheet are then not found. It used a `z_floor` below the model.
   - A shared `closed` state lets adjacent openings lift each other. The prototype used a lid for each component (`lid_of`).
   - `ring8` can pull a flat lid up onto an adjacent boss, or into air or a neighbour hole. The prototype limited the `ring8` expansion by height.
   - A flat lid on a tilted roof makes a vertical cliff. The prototype fit a tilted lid plane (least squares) when the rim Z span is more than `tol`.
2. `crates/motion/src/finishing3d/edge.rs` and `support.rs`: a shallow lid edge or step edge leaves a `sqrt(2 r dz)` stretch where `support_at` gives no answer. The prototype added an edge and vertex drop (`step_edge_drop`), limited to a small height and checked by `ball_clear`.

## What to do

1. Reproduce each item on `main` with a test model. Do not use the prototype result as proof.
2. If an item gives a wrong toolpath, raise this issue to the defect priority (P1 to P3) or file a separate defect.
3. Add a pinning test for each change. A change to `support_at` can change the posted output of all 3D finishes: run `golden_cl` and `verify`.

## Notes

- The #2431 fix bridges the `sqrt(2 r dz)` stretch inside one raster line already. Item 2 is still open for the other strategies that use `support_at`.
- PR #1713 also changes `raster_pass_spaced`.
